summary: V2 auth guards (oauth2_scheme, get_current_user, require_supervisor) and 5 DI factories appended cleanly. All existing V1/V2/V3 factories preserved intact. Imports resolve, signatures match LLD, DS-018/DS-019 semantics correctly implemented.

spec.notes: All 8 required exports present (oauth2_scheme, get_current_user, require_supervisor, get_auth_service, get_inward_report_service, get_pricing_service, get_invoice_service, get_report_export_service). Function signatures match lld.functions[] exactly. tokenUrl='/api/v1/auth/login' matches LLD prose (not the plan MD's shorter '/auth/login') — this is correct per DS-010 API versioning.

contract.notes: Imports use 'src.' prefix consistent with the existing file (plan MD showed unprefixed as illustrative). All imported symbols exist and resolve: src.domain.auth.decode_access_token (verified), src.infrastructure.db.repositories.auth.UserRepository.get_by_username (verified), all 5 V2 services accept a single db=Session constructor argument (verified). Existing 12 V1/V2/V3 factories untouched — append-only rule honoured.

test.notes: test_case_refs is empty by design (transitive coverage via Wave 5 router tests TC-208..TC-217). Manual DoD test 'from src.presentation.api.dependencies import get_current_user, require_supervisor, get_auth_service' will succeed.

security.notes: DS-018 satisfied: decode_access_token result checked for None (invalid/expired), sub claim checked for presence, then UserRepository.get_by_username re-fetches user and re-checks is_active on every request (deactivation takes effect immediately). WWW-Authenticate: Bearer header on all 401 responses (RFC 6750). DS-019 satisfied: require_supervisor raises 403 for non-SUPERVISOR role, matching the CHECK constraint literal 'SUPERVISOR' in the migration. No credentials logged, no secrets embedded, no injection vector (username is used as a bound parameter in the repository).

structural.notes: New symbols are reachable via main.py include_router wiring (Wave 5 routers depend on these DI factories per LLD). No orphaned functions — every added symbol is consumed by at least one downstream router or dependency chain (require_supervisor -> get_current_user -> oauth2_scheme + get_db; 5 factories each Depends'd from their respective routers).

adr_alignment.note: Presentation layer (dependencies.py) constructs services which construct repositories — no router-to-repository shortcut.
OAuth2PasswordBearer + JWT decode via decode_access_token; is_active re-checked on every request; 401 with Bearer challenge.
Role check against string literal 'SUPERVISOR' matches the enum column values in tbl_user_master.
